# UI index: what to use for a need in Helios

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask ui-index` from the `/// Need (group): ...`
doc lines of Helios's crates and of the egui-pop crates in Cargo.lock.
Do not edit: add or change a `Need` line on the item, then run the task
again. A test fails when this file is stale. -->

**Helios makes no widgets.** Before writing any egui call, find the need
here and use what it names: **the Helios preset first** (`helios_ui`,
later `helios_rack`); the egui-pop widget under it only where Helios has
no preset yet. A need missing from this page is a gap to fill in
egui-pop (then a preset here), not a reason to hand-draw it. See
[docs/design/ui-responsibilities.md](design/ui-responsibilities.md).

`ui.*` methods come from egui-pop's `UiPop` trait (`egui_pop::prelude`).
To add an entry, give the public item a doc line
`/// Need (group): a search field.`, a preset using the same words as
the widget it wraps; the group is one of: `text`, `layout`, `action`, `input`, `state`, `status`, `icon`, `help`, `dialog`, `data`, `image`.

egui-pop in the lock: 0.19.0.

## Text and titles

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a heading over a group of fields | **`helios_ui::section(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::section` | A section's header: the theme's section space, its title in the section text role, its description in the muted one. |
|  | `ui.section_title(..)` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::section_title` | A section's title (`text-role.section`). |
| a label in a named text role (title, section, body, muted, meta) | `ui.text_role(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::text_role` | A label in a text role (`role_text`). |
| a section title | **`helios_ui::section(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::section` | A section's header: the theme's section space, its title in the section text role, its description in the muted one. |
|  | `ui.section_title(..)` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::section_title` | A section's title (`text-role.section`). |
| greyed or weak text | `ui.muted(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::muted` | Secondary text: a hint, a description (`text-role.muted`). |
| monospace text, a log or console line, a path or code | `ui.code_text(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::code_text` | Monospace text: a log's or a console's line, a path, a piece of code. |
| secondary text, a hint or a description | `ui.muted(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::muted` | Secondary text: a hint, a description (`text-role.muted`). |
| small print about an item, a date or a size | `ui.meta(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::meta` | Small print about an item: a date, a size (`text-role.meta`). |
| strong or bold text inline, a word that must stand out | `ui.strong_text(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::strong_text` | Inline emphasis: a word or a value that must stand out in running text, at the body's size in a heavier weight (`text-role.strong`, `strong_text`). |
| text in a tone, a failed state or an error in the danger colour | `ui.text_tone(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::text_tone` | Text in a tone: a failed state, an error, a warning, a success. |

## Spacing, cards and scrolling

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a card, a framed group | `ui.card(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::card` | `add` inside the kit's `card` in a tone (`Tone::Neutral` for the plain card). |
| a dialog's body, its buttons kept in view below it | **`helios_ui::scroll(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::scroll` | `add` in a region scrolling up and down: egui-pop's scroll area (the kit's bars, the keys). |
| a divider, a rule between two sections (separator) | `ui.divider(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::divider` | A divider: a rule across the layout between two sections, in `border.default`, one point wide on whole physical pixels, centred in a space of `Space::Group`. |
| a form in a side panel's section, a share of its height | **`helios_ui::scroll(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::scroll` | `add` in a region scrolling up and down: egui-pop's scroll area (the kit's bars, the keys). |
| a group that folds and opens inside a panel (a disclosure, a collapsing header) | `Fold` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::fold::Fold` | A group inside a panel whose header row folds and opens its body: a section band (disclosure mark, title, count) with optional actions at its right end, its body indented below it when open. |
| a list filling a strip beside another region, its bar on the strip's edge | **`helios_ui::scroll(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::scroll` | `add` in a region scrolling up and down: egui-pop's scroll area (the kit's bars, the keys). |
| a list in a side panel's section, a few rows high | **`helios_ui::scroll(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::scroll` | `add` in a region scrolling up and down: egui-pop's scroll area (the kit's bars, the keys). |
| a log filling its panel, the newest line kept in view | **`helios_ui::scroll(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::scroll` | `add` in a region scrolling up and down: egui-pop's scroll area (the kit's bars, the keys). |
| a scrolling region | **`helios_ui::scroll(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::scroll` | `add` in a region scrolling up and down: egui-pop's scroll area (the kit's bars, the keys). |
|  | `ui.scroll_area(..)` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::scroll_area` | Shows egui's scroll area with its bars drawn from the kit's `scroll-bar` (`Stock::ScrollBar`: the thumb's fills and corners, the track), `add` its content, drawn in this `Ui`'s own style. |
| a tab bar button that moves a whole tab group into a window of its own | `DockControls` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::workbench::DockControls` | The controls the workbench's docks show beyond the tabs, as the application sets them (`AppBuilder::dock_controls`). |
| a widget of a fixed size, filling its box (add_sized) | `ui.sized(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::sized` | `widget` in a box of `size` at the layout's cursor, filling it (centred and justified along the layout's direction): a row the width of its room, a field of a set width. |
| collapsible sections in a panel | `Sections` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::sections::Sections` | A stack of collapsible sections filling the room it is given (a panel's height), named for its memory and for agents. |
| content in a box of a fixed size (allocate_ui_with_layout) | `ui.sized_ui(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::sized_ui` | `add` in a box of exactly `size` at the layout's cursor, laid out by `layout` (`Layout::centered_and_justified` to fill it): a cell of a set width in a row. |
| content placed in a given rectangle, clipped to it (put) | `ui.rect_ui(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::rect_ui` | `add` in `rect`, laid out by `layout` and clipped to it, for what places its parts by rectangles (a card laid out by a layout engine, a slot): nothing it draws goes past `rect`. |
| one of egui's own widgets, styled by the kit | `ui.scoped(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::scoped` | `add` in a scope where egui's own widgets of a `Stock` kind (buttons, combo boxes, text fields, buttons shown on or off) are drawn from the kit's component, in a tone: its states become egui's widget visuals, so egui keeps drawing the widget (`Kit::scope`). |
| space between blocks, by intent (never a number of points) | `ui.space_role(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::space_role` | Space by intent along the layout's direction (`Space`); egui's own `add_space` takes points. |
| the tail of a console, the newest line kept in view | **`helios_ui::scroll(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::scroll` | `add` in a region scrolling up and down: egui-pop's scroll area (the kit's bars, the keys). |

## Buttons and actions

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a button by tone (primary, danger, quiet) | **`helios_ui::action(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::action` | A button for `kind` of action, labelled `label`: egui-pop's button in the action's tone. |
|  | `ui.button_tone(..)` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::button_tone` | egui's button in a tone of the kit's `button` (`button.tone.*`): a `Stock::Button` scope (`UiPop::scoped`), so the button keeps its layout, icon and shortcut text. |
| a button with a menu of alternatives (split button) | `input::split_button(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::split_button` | A split button on its own: an action (`text`) and a chevron opening a menu of `items`. |
| a small (compact) button in a dense list row | `RowButton` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::compact::RowButton` | A button small enough for a list's row (see the module). |
| a small action in a list's row (Cancel beside a job) | **`helios_ui::row_action(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::row_action` | A small button for `kind` of action in a list's row, labelled `label` (Cancel or Retry beside a job): egui-pop's compact row button in the action's tone, no taller than the row. |
| a small frameless text button in a bar (a breadcrumb, a name in a title bar) | `widgets::bar_text_button(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::widgets::bar_text_button` | A frameless text button sized for a bar: small text, no box, as wide as its text, egui's hover look (its text brightens under the pointer) and the focus ring when it has the keyboard. |
| an icon button | `IconWidget` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::icon::IconWidget` | An icon as a widget. |
| the screen's primary or secondary action | **`helios_ui::action(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::action` | A button for `kind` of action, labelled `label`: egui-pop's button in the action's tone. |

## Fields and choices

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a checkbox | `widgets::checkbox(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::widgets::checkbox` | A checkbox (`Checkbox`): `ui.checkbox`, drawn through the kit. |
| a colour picked on a wheel | `ColorWheel` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::viewport::wheel::ColorWheel` | A colour wheel, with its luminance slider. |
| a drop-down choice (combo box) | **`helios_ui::choice(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::choice` | A drop-down over `current`, one row per option (its value and the words shown for it): egui-pop's combo box and selectable rows. |
|  | `ui.combo_box(..)` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::combo_box` | Shows egui's combo box (`widgets::combo_box`, for the kit's arrow) with its box drawn from the kit's `combo-box` (`Stock::ComboBox`), `add` its list's content: `ComboBox::show_ui` in a scope. |
| a file or folder path field | `Input::path(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::path` | A path field. |
| a filter box | **`helios_ui::search(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::search` | A search field over `query` for `search`: egui-pop's search input (magnifier, clearable), named and hinted by its scope, as wide as the space given. |
|  | `Input::search(..)` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::search` | A search field: a magnifier before the query, clearable. |
| a filter picked from a short list of options | **`helios_ui::choice(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::choice` | A drop-down over `current`, one row per option (its value and the words shown for it): egui-pop's combo box and selectable rows. |
| a masked field for a secret (token, API key) | `Input::masked(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::masked` | A masked text field (a password, a token, a key): every character a bullet, nothing to copy, and its value never given to assistive technologies or agents, only its name. |
| a multi-line text field (a description, notes) | `Input::multiline(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::multiline` | A multi-line text field: `rows` lines tall, growing with its text up to `max_rows`, then scrolling; Enter starts a new line, Ctrl+Enter submits (see `submit_on_enter`). |
| a number field with a unit | `Input::number(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::number` | A number field: a number or an expression (`x * 2`, `1,5`), committed when it loses the focus. |
| a number field with steps and limits | `NumberInput` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::number::NumberInput` | A number input; see the module. |
| a password field | `Input::masked(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::masked` | A masked text field (a password, a token, a key): every character a bullet, nothing to copy, and its value never given to assistive technologies or agents, only its name. |
| a rotary knob | `Knob` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::knob::Knob` | A rotary knob over an `f64`. |
| a search field | **`helios_ui::search(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::search` | A search field over `query` for `search`: egui-pop's search input (magnifier, clearable), named and hinted by its scope, as wide as the space given. |
|  | `Input::search(..)` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::search` | A search field: a magnifier before the query, clearable. |
| a single-line text field | `Input::text(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::text` | A text field named `label` (for assistive technologies and agents; the label itself is drawn by the form around it). |
| a slider over a number | `Slider` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::slider::Slider` | A slider over an `f64`. |
| a star rating | `RatingStars` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::rating::RatingStars` | Five stars (see the module). |
| a text area that grows with its text | `Input::multiline(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::multiline` | A multi-line text field: `rows` lines tall, growing with its text up to `max_rows`, then scrolling; Enter starts a new line, Ctrl+Enter submits (see `submit_on_enter`). |
| a text field with a placeholder | `Input::text(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::input::Input::text` | A text field named `label` (for assistive technologies and agents; the label itself is drawn by the form around it). |
| a toggle chip, a filter turned on or off | `ToggleChip` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::widgets::ToggleChip` | A small toggle showing a short text or a glyph, on while `selected`: its box is the kit's `toggle-chip` component (based on `selectable-row`), its text or glyph in the state's `text`. |
| an on/off switch (a toggle with a track and a thumb) | `Switch` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::widgets::Switch` | An on/off switch: a track (the kit's `switch` component, `selected` while on) and a round thumb, at the track's start while off and at its end while on, in the state's `text`; its label after it, in the `text` of the same state off. |
| one choice among a few (radio buttons) | `widgets::radio_value(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::widgets::radio_value` | A radio button setting `current` to `alternative` when clicked: `ui.radio_value`, drawn through the kit. |

## Loading, empty and progress

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a busy spinner | `Spinner` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::progress::Spinner` | A spinner, with a label after it; `Spinner::delayed` shows it only after `motion.spinner.delay`, and keeps it `motion.spinner.min`. |
| a job's progress, a bar when it counts and a spinner when it does not | **`helios_ui::progress(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::progress` | The progress of the work named `name` (its accessible name): egui-pop's progress bar at `fraction` (0 to 1), or its spinner when the work does not say how far it is. |
| a place that failed to load, with Retry | **`helios_ui::failed(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::failed` | A place that failed to load: egui-pop's empty state in danger, with `title`, the `reason` and a Retry action (egui-pop's translated "Retry"). |
| a progress bar | **`helios_ui::progress(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::progress` | The progress of the work named `name` (its accessible name): egui-pop's progress bar at `fraction` (0 to 1), or its spinner when the work does not say how far it is. |
|  | `ProgressBar` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::progress::ProgressBar` | A progress bar. |
| a small circular progress | `Ring` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::progress::Ring` | A small circular progress: determinate (an arc from the top) or indeterminate (a turning arc). |
| a value or a list still loading | **`helios_ui::loading(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::loading` | What loads, shown in its shape: egui-pop's skeleton, busy for assistive technologies and named "Loading". |
|  | `Skeleton` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::placeholder::Skeleton` | Grey shapes standing in for content. |
| a value still loading | `Spinner` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::progress::Spinner` | A spinner, with a label after it; `Spinner::delayed` shows it only after `motion.spinner.delay`, and keeps it `motion.spinner.min`. |
| a value that refreshes, its last value kept meanwhile | **`helios_ui::value(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::value` | The value in egui-pop's late-value cell: a skeleton sized for its kind while pending, the value, the last value with a small spinner while refreshing, the reason with Retry once failed. |
| a value worked out late (a size, a count), with its waiting states | **`helios_ui::value(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::value` | The value in egui-pop's late-value cell: a skeleton sized for its kind while pending, the value, the last value with a small spinner while refreshing, the reason with Retry once failed. |
| an empty album, with the way back to all photos | **`helios_ui::empty(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::empty` | The empty state of `case`: egui-pop's empty state (icon, title, sentence, action), in the language the application shows. |
| an empty state, nothing here yet | **`helios_ui::empty(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::empty` | The empty state of `case`: egui-pop's empty state (icon, title, sentence, action), in the language the application shows. |
|  | `EmptyState` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::placeholder::EmptyState` | An empty place: an icon, a title, a sentence, an action. |
| no results for a search or a filter | **`helios_ui::empty(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::empty` | The empty state of `case`: egui-pop's empty state (icon, title, sentence, action), in the language the application shows. |
|  | `EmptyState` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::placeholder::EmptyState` | An empty place: an icon, a title, a sentence, an action. |
| placeholder shapes while content loads | **`helios_ui::loading(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::loading` | What loads, shown in its shape: egui-pop's skeleton, busy for assistive technologies and named "Loading". |
|  | `Skeleton` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::core::placeholder::Skeleton` | Grey shapes standing in for content. |
| what restricts a list or a gallery, removable | **`helios_ui::restriction(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::restriction` | One thing limiting what a view shows ("Album: Trip"), as a chip the user removes to lift it: egui-pop's removable tag chip, its remove button named "Remove {text}". |

## Status marks and badges

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a colour swatch | `Indicator` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::indicator::Indicator` | A micro-indicator, built then added inline (`ui.add`) or painted on a widget (`Indicator::on`, `Indicator::paint_at`). |
| a level against thresholds (disk space, memory) | `Meter` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::progress::Meter` | A value against thresholds (disk space, memory), not progress: a bar whose tone follows the highest threshold reached. |
| a status dot, a LED, a count badge or a flag | `Indicator` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::indicator::Indicator` | A micro-indicator, built then added inline (`ui.add`) or painted on a widget (`Indicator::on`, `Indicator::paint_at`). |
| an inline error, warning or success message | `ui.text_tone(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::text_tone` | Text in a tone: a failed state, an error, a warning, a success. |

## Icons and glyphs

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a small mark by meaning (disclosure, sort, check, close) | `Glyph` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::kit::Glyph` | What a small mark means. |
| an icon as a widget (sized, toned, clickable) | `IconWidget` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::icon::IconWidget` | An icon as a widget. |
| an icon by name | `Icon` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::icon::Icon` | What an icon means. |

## Tooltips, hover cards and notices

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a hover card, a rich tooltip with rows and links | `HoverCard` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::hover_card::HoverCard` | A hover card next to a widget. |
| a toast, a short notice that fades | **`helios_ui::notify(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::notify` | Raises `text` at `level`: a toast of egui-pop's toasts service. |
|  | `Toasts` (egui-pop, under the preset)<br>`egui_pop::api::toasts::Toasts` | The queue of toasts. |
| a tooltip | `.tip(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::tooltip::TooltipExt::tip` | Shows `text` in the kit's tooltip while the widget is hovered and enabled, as `Response::on_hover_text` does with egui's. |
| why a control is disabled | `.disabled_tip(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::tooltip::TooltipExt::disabled_tip` | Shows `text` in the kit's tooltip while the widget is hovered and disabled (the reason it is), as `Response::on_disabled_hover_text`. |

## Dialogs, menus and pages

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a command palette | `Palette` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::palette::Palette` | The palettes' state, one per window group (`AppHandle::window_group`): open or not, the query. |
| a command row with its shortcut in a menu drawn by hand | `menus::command_row(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::menus::command_row` | A command row in a menu drawn by hand (a popup or context menu built in a closure), drawn as the declared menus' command rows: the kit's `menu-item`, its label at the start, `shortcut` (the keys' text, such as `Ctrl+C`) muted at the end in the menu's key font. |
| a confirmation dialog | `Confirm` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::dialogs::Confirm` | A question before an action: a primary button and Cancel, or, with a `Secondary`, the classic three buttons ("Save", "Don't save", "Cancel") in the platform's order (`ButtonOrder`). |
| a file or folder picker | `FileBrowser` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::files::browser::FileBrowser` | The file browser: entries from a `FileSource`, shown by a `ViewMode` chosen in its toolbar (or with `Ctrl+1` to `Ctrl+9`), kept per dialog in the host's store when drawn with `FileBrowser::show_in`. |
| a popover's surface in an area the application places itself | `ui.popover(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::popover` | `add` on the kit's popover surface (its `popover` component, with egui's popup shadow): the look of egui-pop's own popovers, for an area the application places itself (a first-run notice, a hint by a control), outside the overlay stack. |
| a settings or admin page declared as a manifest | `Admin` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::admin::Admin` | The administration app's state, manifests, hooks, widget kinds and value layers. |
| a side panel of places, with sections of an application's | `PlacesPanel` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::files::places::PlacesPanel` | A side panel of places: sections, each a heading over its items, as the in-app picker lists them (an import window's sources column). |
| a submenu in a context menu drawn by hand | `menus::submenu(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::menus::submenu` | A submenu item in a menu drawn by hand (a context menu built in a closure, `egui_pop_core::pointer::claim::context_menu`), drawn as the declared menus' submenu items: the kit's `menu-item` with the submenu arrow, `selected` while its submenu is open. |
| a three-button question (Save, Don't save, Cancel) | `Confirm` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::dialogs::Confirm` | A question before an action: a primary button and Cancel, or, with a `Secondary`, the classic three buttons ("Save", "Don't save", "Cancel") in the platform's order (`ButtonOrder`). |
| ask before a destructive action | `Confirm` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::dialogs::Confirm` | A question before an action: a primary button and Cancel, or, with a `Secondary`, the classic three buttons ("Save", "Don't save", "Cancel") in the platform's order (`ButtonOrder`). |

## Lists, trees and tables

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a details grid, names and their values | **`helios_ui::details(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::details` | A details grid: one line per `(name, value)`, the names in a column as wide as the widest, the values taking the rest: egui-pop's grid, its header cells and body text. |
| a long list, virtualised | `ListView` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::views::list::ListView` | The list widget. |
| a row of a hand-built tree with its disclosure toggle (a folder tree in a side panel) | `TreeRow` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::fold::TreeRow` | A row of a hand-built tree: a branch's toggle, or a leaf's room for one, then the row the caller draws; `TreeRowResponse::body` shows the rows below a branch, indented, when it is open. |
| a row picked from a short list | `SelectableRow` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::widgets::SelectableRow` | A row picked from a short list: its box is the kit's `selectable-row` component, `selected` for the chosen one (never `hover` then, so the choice stays visible under the pointer), its label in the state's `text`. |
| a sortable column header | `SortHeader` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::widgets::SortHeader` | A column's header: its box is the kit's `table-header-cell` component, `selected` while the rows are sorted by it, the direction the kit's `sort-ascending` or `sort-descending` glyph after the title. |
| a table with sortable, resizable columns | `DataTable` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::views::table::DataTable` | The data table widget. |
| a tree, lazy and keyboard-driven | `TreeView` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::views::tree::TreeView` | The tree widget. |
| many rows of equal height, only the visible ones drawn | `ui.scroll_area_rows(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::ui::UiPop::scroll_area_rows` | `UiPop::scroll_area` for `rows` rows `row_height` high, the `Ui`'s item spacing apart: egui's `ScrollArea::show_rows`, `add` given the rows in view. |
| the properties of one item, in two columns | **`helios_ui::details(..)`** (Helios preset)<br>`helios_ui::details` | A details grid: one line per `(name, value)`, the names in a column as wide as the widest, the values taking the rest: egui-pop's grid, its header cells and body text. |

## Images and imaging

| Need | Use | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| a colour wheel | `ColorWheel` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::viewport::wheel::ColorWheel` | A colour wheel, with its luminance slider. |
| a curve editor | `CurveEditor` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::viewport::curve::CurveEditor` | The curve editor. |
| a grid of thumbnails | `ThumbnailGrid` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::core::thumbnail::ThumbnailGrid` | `thumbnail_grid` with its options: where it keeps its scrolling, how high it gets, and a cell to bring into view, drawn or not. |
| a histogram | `Histogram` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::viewport::histogram::Histogram` | The histogram widget. |
| a zoom control | `ZoomControl` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::viewport::navigator::ZoomControl` | The zoom control: zoom out, the zoom, zoom in, fit, 100 %. |
| an application's logo in its own title bar, beside its name | `.logo(..)` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::api::frame::FramePlugin::logo` | The application's logo, drawn after the system menu button and before its name, a toolbar icon's size (`size.icon.toolbar`), so the application keeps the frame's menu block instead of replacing it. |
| an image navigator (overview with the visible area) | `Navigator` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::viewport::navigator::Navigator` | The navigator: the whole image and the part in view. |
| an image viewport (pan, zoom, tiles) | `Viewport` (egui-pop)<br>`egui_pop::viewport::widget::Viewport` | The viewport widget, built per frame. |
